annotations.title: Work out how much house someone can afford

description: Maximum affordable home price from income, existing debt payments and available down payment, using the 28/36 qualifying ratios. Reports which of the two ratios is the binding constraint, which is the actionable part: a buyer limited by the back-end ratio can raise their budget by clearing debt, one limited by the front-end ratio cannot.

inputSchema.description: Maximum affordable home price from income, debts and available down payment.

annualGrossIncome.description: Household income before tax, in US dollars per year.

annualInterestRatePercent.description: Annual nominal interest rate as a percentage, for example 6.5 for 6.5%.

backEndRatioPercent.description: Maximum total debt as a share of gross income. 36 is conservative; lenders often allow 45 and sometimes 50.

downPaymentAmount.description: Cash available for the down payment, in US dollars. A dollar amount, not a percentage.

frontEndRatioPercent.description: Maximum housing cost as a share of gross income. 28 is the conservative standard.

loanTermYears.description: Loan term in years. Most US mortgages are 15 or 30.

monthlyDebtPayments.description: Existing minimum monthly debt payments: car loans, student loans, credit card minimums. Excludes housing.

propertyTaxRatePercent.description: Annual property tax as a percentage of home value. Omit and pass `state` instead to use that state's average.

state.description: Full US state name, for example "Texas". Used to look up the average property tax rate. Either this or propertyTaxRatePercent is required.

name: calculate_affordability

outputSchema.description: Maximum home price implied by income, down payment and standard debt-to-income limits.

backEndLimit.description: Total-debt-to-income limit used, as a percentage.

disclaimer.description: Estimate-only notice that should accompany any figure shown to a person.

downPaymentPercent.description: Down payment as a percentage of the maximum price.

estimatedMonthlyInsurance.description: Estimated monthly homeowners insurance, in dollars.

estimatedMonthlyPmi.description: Estimated monthly mortgage insurance, in dollars.

estimatedMonthlyPropertyTax.description: Estimated monthly property tax, in dollars.

frontEndLimit.description: Housing-cost-to-income limit used, as a percentage.

maxHomePrice.description: Highest home price the inputs support, in dollars.

maxLoanAmount.description: Largest loan the inputs support, in dollars.

maxMonthlyHousingPayment.description: Largest affordable monthly housing payment, in dollars.

maxMonthlyPrincipalAndInterest.description: Largest affordable monthly principal and interest.

title: Work out how much house someone can afford
